title: Battle of Ravine-à-Couleuvres
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ravine-à-Couleuvres", at revision 1370587281, opens: "The Battle of Ravine-à-Couleuvres, fought on 23 February 1802, was a major battle of the Saint-Domingue expedition during the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890563, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1802 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
